diagnostics.actual_sql: SELECT SUM(("t0"."quantity" * "t0"."unit_price") - "t0"."discount_amount") AS "total_revenue", SUM("t0"."quantity") AS "total_quantity", SUM("t0"."discount_amount") AS "total_discount_amount" FROM "t0" LIMIT 101
SELECT "t0"."region" AS "region", COUNT(DISTINCT "t0"."order_id") AS "order_count" FROM "t0" GROUP BY "t0"."region" ORDER BY "order_count" DESC, "region" ASC LIMIT 1001

SELECT AVG(("t0"."quantity" * "t0"."unit_price") - "t0"."discount_amount") AS "avg_revenue_per_order", SUM(("t0"."quantity" * "t0"."unit_price") - "t0"."discount_amount") AS "total_revenue" FROM "t0" LIMIT 1001

SELECT CAST(DATE_TRUNC('month', "t0"."order_date") AS DATE) AS "period", SUM(("t0"."quantity" * "t0"."unit_price") - "t0"."discount_amount") AS "sales_revenue" FROM "t0" GROUP BY CAST(DATE_TRUNC('month', "t0"."order_date") AS DATE) ORDER BY "period" ASC LIMIT 1001

SELECT CAST(DATE_TRUNC('month', "t0"."order_date") AS DATE) AS "period", COUNT("t0"."order_id") AS "order_count" FROM "t0" GROUP BY CAST(DATE_TRUNC('month', "t0"."order_date") AS DATE) ORDER BY "period" ASC LIMIT 1001

SELECT CAST(DATE_TRUNC('month', "t0"."order_date") AS DATE) AS "period", SUM(("t0"."quantity" * "t0"."unit_price") - "t0"."discount_amount") AS "revenue" FROM "t0" WHERE "t0"."region" = ? GROUP BY CAST(DATE_TRUNC('month', "t0"."order_date") AS DATE) ORDER BY "period" ASC LIMIT 1001
